cards.design_implication: If adopting similar structural reporting criteria, experimental designs may target these specific ultrastructural features for visualization within whole-cell volume contexts.
does_not_establish: Statistical validity of the structural reports.
Reproducibility of these specific observations in other systems.
The existence or efficacy of any controls used to verify these structures.
cards.evidence_excerpt: Here we report critical SARS-CoV-2 structural events - e.g. viral RNA transport portals, virus assembly intermediates, virus egress pathway, and native virus spike structures, in the context of whole-cell volumes revealing drastic cytppathic changes.
limitations: The excerpt only lists these structures as reported events in a specific study.
It does not define quantitative metrics for measurability or validation protocols for these structures.
cards.statement: SARS-CoV-2 structural events, including viral RNA transport portals, virus assembly intermediates, virus egress pathway, and native virus spike structures, are reported as observable in the context of whole-cell volumes.

cards.design_implication: For studies aiming to correlate cytopathic events with virus replication in native cellular contexts, a design incorporating this specific combination of cryo-imaging modalities may be considered.
does_not_establish: Eligibility criteria for cell selection beyond the use of Vero cells.
cards.evidence_excerpt: To correlate cytopathic events induced by SARS-CoV-2 with virus replication processes in frozen-hydrated cells, we established a unique multi-modal, multi-scale cryo-correlative platform to image SARS-CoV-2 infection in Vero cells. This platform combines serial cryoFIB/SEM volume imaging and soft X-ray cryo-tomography with cell lamellae-based cryo-electron tomography (cryoET) and subtomogram averaging.
limitations: Does not specify sampling rates, number of cells, or randomization procedures.
Does not detail instrument settings or calibration standards.
cards.statement: The study establishes a multi-modal, multi-scale cryo-correlative platform to image SARS-CoV-2 infection in Vero cells, combining serial cryoFIB/SEM volume imaging, soft X-ray cryo-tomography, and cell lamellae-based cryo-electron tomography with subtomogram averaging.
